Type `@` for files or `/` at the start for skills. A file is pending while it loads, and sending marks each skill as running, then done, with `updateToken()`. Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line.
UI SDK adds a little CSS of its own in a cascade layer named `ui-sdk`. Declare that layer at the top of your global stylesheet, above the Tailwind import, so your classes win over it.
Undoes the last step. Typing is grouped, and pastes and token changes are steps of their own.
What a token says to screen readers besides its label.
With `readOnly`, the text stays focusable, selectable and submitted, but typing, pastes and drops leave it alone.
With `submitShortcut="mod+enter"`, Enter adds a line and Command or Control+Enter sends, which many Japanese and Chinese writers prefer.
With a `name`, the input submits its text with each token written as `[@label](type:value)`. `required` blocks an empty submit, and a reset goes back to `defaultValue`.
`tokenDeletion` sets what Backspace does at a token. `whole` removes it, `select` selects it first, and `revert` turns it back into text.
